EMPLOYEE LEAVE & WORKPLACE POLICY
Policy ID: HR-LEAVE-001
Version: 1.0
Effective Date: 1 January 2026
1. Policy Overview
This policy explains the leave entitlements, application process, attendance expectations, and
responsibilities applicable to employees of Example Technologies Pvt. Ltd.
2. Scope
This policy applies to all full-time employees of Example Technologies Pvt. Ltd. Part-time employees
and contractors are subject to the terms of their respective agreements.
3. Annual Leave Eligibility
Employees who have completed at least 6 months of continuous service may request up to 18 days of
annual leave during each calendar year.
4. Leave Application
Employees must submit planned annual leave requests through the employee portal at least 7 calendar
days before the first day of leave.
Leave requests are subject to manager approval. Approval depends on operational requirements and
team availability.
5. Sick Leave
Employees may take up to 10 days of sick leave per calendar year. For sick leave lasting more than 2
consecutive working days, the employee must provide appropriate supporting documentation when
requested by HR.
6. Emergency Leave
In an unexpected emergency, an employee should notify their manager as soon as reasonably possible.
The 7-day advance notice requirement does not apply to genuine emergencies.
7. Employee Responsibilities
Employees must keep their leave records accurate, provide truthful information, complete required
approval steps, and return to work on the agreed date.
8. Restrictions
Employees must not take leave without the required approval except where an emergency or other
exception explicitly covered by this policy applies.

9. Important Limits
Annual leave entitlement is limited to 18 days per calendar year for eligible employees. Sick leave is
limited to 10 days per calendar year under this policy.
10. Exceptions
Exceptions to this policy may be considered where another written company policy, employment
agreement, or applicable internal procedure explicitly provides different terms.
11. Contact
Questions about this policy should be directed to the Human Resources team. This document is a
fictional sample created for software testing and demonstration.
